supersedes_for_future_execution.reason: v1 aligned candidate masks to the square encoder frame but did not explicitly exclude black square-padding tokens from the dilated local-context descriptor

scientific_role: complete coordinate-frame correction for mask-conditioned RAD-DINO proposal descriptors; v2 includes v1 proposal projection plus fractional source-content validity for both proposal and local-context pooling

geometry_contract.candidate_input_frame: direct-resize coordinates of the unpadded source radiograph
geometry_contract.proposal_projection: continuous content_box/padded_side transform, bilinear sampling, zero outside content, four samples per 32x32 token axis, then area pooling
geometry_contract.content_validity: project an all-one unpadded source mask through the identical transform to obtain fractional square-frame source-content occupancy
geometry_contract.inside_pool: candidate occupancy multiplied by fractional source-content occupancy
geometry_contract.context_pool: existing radius-two token dilation minus proposal occupancy, then multiplied by fractional source-content occupancy so black padding never enters the local-ring mean
geometry_contract.flip: horizontally flip both the already projected proposal and its projected content-validity map

single_scientific_change_relative_to_run: correct the candidate/content coordinate system used only for RAD-DINO descriptor pooling
unchanged_from_parent: split, group IDs, train/validation images and image labels
classifier, SAM, RAD-DINO and proposal-generation checkpoints
all candidate masks, order, metadata and candidate oracle
scorer architecture, normalized LogSumExp, self-guided instance loss and flip-consistency loss
seed, optimizer, weights, warm-up and 16 final-only epochs
all prediction-freeze artifacts, evaluator, complete misses, bootstrap, gate and operational goals
additional_required_test: inject extreme-valued tokens only in square padding and prove that the proposal local-context mean and contrast are unchanged when fractional content validity is supplied

execution.launch_condition: audit running v6 first; launch only if v6 does not meet all operational goals and its frozen candidate oracle still meets them
execution.accelerator: two real Tesla T4 GPUs on Kaggle
execution.tests_before_heavy_work: all tensor, source, provenance, T4x2 and prediction-boundary tests must pass in the Kaggle environment with Torch
execution.monitor: one separate-task monitor at ten-minute cadence
execution.comparison: corrected-v2 minus running-v6 and both arms versus promoted flip-TTA baseline, paired complete-group bootstrap 10000
execution.gate: unchanged all-checks-required parent gate followed by the separately frozen consumer-entry gate

forbidden: executing v1 after v2 was frozen
using validation GT to modify content validity or any other setting
changing proposals, losses, epochs, seed, selection threshold, evaluator or gates
consumer training before every required prediction-first gate
